items.prompt: A proposed partition has lower values [1,9] and upper [4,8]. Why can equal sizes still fail?

options.text: Both sides must contain distinct values.
options.why: Duplicates are allowed; distinctness is unrelated to this failure.

options.text: Even prefixes must put all values in lower.
options.why: Balanced halves are required for an even prefix.
Correct sizes alone do not ensure the roots are the two middle sorted values.

options.text: A median cannot be represented in half units.
options.why: The median of four integers is always an integer or half-integer.

items.explanation: Correct sizes alone do not ensure the roots are the two middle sorted values.
